name: Jaraíz de la Vera (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Jaraíz de la Vera (a castle between lions on blue).
history: The municipal council approved the file for the adoption of the arms and the flag in plenary session on 28 November 1996 and they were approved on 26 September 1997; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three equal vertical stripes, green next to the staff, yellow in the centre and blue at the fly, with the municipal arms on the central stripe.

features.role: Jaraíz de la Vera arms — castle between lions on blue
